settings.heading: When do we deliver in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?
settings.text: Delivered within 2hrs across Dubai and Abu Dhabi daily 11am to 8:30pm daily. For Sharjah and Ajman same day delivery for orders confirmed before 1pm daily

settings.heading: Is your packaging safe to use?
settings.text: Yes, 100%! Sustainable and responsible packaging is an integral part of our company strategy; we use suppliers including MULTIVAC, one of the leading providers worldwide of packaging solutions for food.

settings.heading: When can I place my order?
settings.text: All orders are delivered within the same-day across Dubai; orders confirmed after 9pm are delivered the next day.

settings.heading: When do you deliver?
settings.text: Express 3-Hours delivery of all fresh meat products across Dubai.

settings.heading: Do I need to tip my delivery driver?
settings.text: There’s no specific requirement to tip your delivery driver — we are committed to paying a living wage that doesn’t depend on tips.

settings.heading: How many collections and origins do we have?
settings.text: We have over 15+ Origins and categories from all across the world.

settings.heading: Is there a refund Policy?
settings.text: Yes, if our meat is not up to your standards and not in good quality, we provide a 100% refund or give an option to replace it. Customer satisfaction comes first to us.
